entities.name: Taaveti
entities.description: Elven hunter of Kelsinko in Fyndhorn who lived in Terisiare during the Ice Age and was killed by a Deathmark.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Guided by Taaveti with her Order of the White Shield.

entities.name: Vannemir
entities.description: Guided by Taaveti on a rescue mission to Guldark's camp.

events.summary: Taaveti guides Lucilde Fiksdotter and her Order of the White Shield.
events.quote: Taaveti once served as a guide for Lucilde Fiksdotter

events.summary: Taaveti guides Vannemir on his rescue mission to Guldark's camp.
events.quote: He also guided Vannemir on his critical rescue mission to Guldark's camp.

events.summary: Taaveti accompanies Kaysa, Jaeuhl Carthalion, Jaya Ballard and Laina to Yavimaya.
events.quote: never took to his new home

events.summary: Taaveti is killed by a Deathmark during the war between New Argive and the Cult of Rimewind.
events.quote: Taaveti was killed by a Deathmark

relations.note: Steadfast ally of the humans of Kjeldor.
relations.quote: A steadfast ally of the humans of Kjeldor and the Juniper Order
